stream.text: Let me look at the build output and the file it points to.

# Why the build failed

The build stopped at **type checking**: `tsc` found *one* error in `src/api/client.ts`, so no bundle was written.

## What happened

1. `pnpm build` runs `tsc --noEmit` before bundling.
2. `fetchUser()` now returns `Promise<User | undefined>`, but `Profile.tsx` still treats it as `User`.
   - The change came in with the cache layer.
   - Nothing else depends on it.
3. The bundler never ran.

> Type errors fail the build on purpose here: `noEmitOnError` is on in `tsconfig.json`.

| File | Line | Error |
|------|-----:|-------|
| `src/pages/Profile.tsx` | 42 | TS2532: Object is possibly 'undefined' |
| `src/api/client.ts` | 17 | (source of the change) |

### The fix

Handle the missing user where it is read:

```tsx
const user = await fetchUser(id);
if (!user) {
  return <NotFound />; // the cache can miss
}
return <ProfileCard user={user} />;
```

Then rebuild:

```sh
pnpm build && pnpm test --filter profile   # about 40s
```

- [x] Found the failing check
- [ ] Apply the fix
- [ ] Re-run the build

See the [TypeScript handbook on narrowing](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/narrowing.html) for why the `if` is enough. Unicode check: 漢字 and 🚀 line up.

---

~~Disabling strict mode~~ would hide this class of bug, so I would not.
